title: feat: back up to external disks and Cloudflare R2 with storage locations

commit.messageHeadline: feat(storage): add pluggable storage locations with filesystem provider
fix(storage): compute sizes without reads and describe provider targets
feat(cloudflare): add R2 storage provider
refactor(backup): prepare storage and scratch owners for offsite arch…
feat(backup): add storage-location archives and health reporting
feat(ui): show backup health in Systems
docs(backup): document storage-location backups and recovery
fix(ui): surface failed Git backup pushes
fix(storage): integrate storage locations phases
fix(storage): use canonical cron path in backup health test
fix(storage): polish live-tested errors, targets, and backup visibility
fix(backup): claim namespaces and keep per-target backup status
test(plugins): classify cloudflare runtime api
build: sync Workboard asset manifest with main
fix(backup): scope offsite health to the schedule namespace
test(e2e): cover backup schedules across a published upgrade
test(e2e): compare persisted backup ledger values
chore: merge main into storage locations
fix(plugin-sdk): keep updater path context internal
chore: align SDK facade with main
docs(cloudflare): add plugin package README
test(e2e): keep upgrade survivor phase order with the backup scenario
fix(backup): preserve status groups across main integration
chore: reconcile SDK surface ratchet with main
fix(backup): fence namespace authority at publication and deletion
build(knip): register the backup upgrade scenario helper
fix(config): declare the storage config tier
fix(doctor): keep backup scratch discovery quiet without recorded scr…
chore: reconcile main for storage branch mergeability
fix(ui): import the missing-scope reader in session group defaults
chore: reconcile manifest contracts for storage branch mergeability
chore: merge main and regenerate config baseline
